'''Suns' Rise Ridge''' was the name given to the ridge that formed the northern edge of [[the Wound]] in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was named for the twin [[Star/Legends|suns]] of the planet.<ref name="TOR:SRR" />
